meta.name: agent-hierarchy
meta.description: Designs orchestrator-and-subagent hierarchies for a repository — splitting agents by exclusive write surface, pairing every producer with an independent auditor, and enforcing the split with a script that runs in CI. Use this whenever the user wants to set up, expand, audit, or fix a multi-agent or subagent structure for a codebase; asks how to divide work between agents; wants agent charters, roles, or a surface map written; or is hitting agents that collide on the same files, review their own work, or drift from their remit. Also use when sizing a roster or deciding whether a new agent is justified.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 划分多个智能代理的职责,给每个配上独立复核,并自动拦截越权改动。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时运行多个智能代理,却常为文件冲突、无人复核或越权改动发愁。
copy.tagline_en: Divide duties among AI agents, add audit checks, and stop boundary conflicts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have multiple AI agents that clash on files or lack independent checks.

howto.what: 当你让 Claude 设计或调整多个 AI 助手的分工，它会坚持按各助手可写入的文件范围划分，而不是按话题；每个写文件的助手要配一个独立的只读审查助手，并用脚本在 CI 中检查不越界。它先盘点真实文件，再提出名单。
howto.when: 当你想搭建、审计或修复代码库里多个 AI 助手的分工，或想给它们写角色/地盘说明时。

say.text: 帮我的项目设计一套多助手分工，按各助手负责的文件来划分。
say.note: 它会先盘点文件，再提出最小分组方案。

say.text: 我的两个助手总改同一个文件，怎么调整分工？
say.note: 它会分析重叠，重新划地盘并配只读审查者。

say.text: 请为现有助手分工写一份 surface map 并配上检查脚本。

howto.what_en: Claude will split agents by exclusive file ownership (not topic), pair each builder with a read-only auditor, and enforce it via a CI script. It inventories the repo, proposes the smallest non-overlapping roster, then writes the surface map and guard.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to set up, audit, or fix a multi-agent structure in a codebase, or want to write role/surface definitions for them.

say_en.text: Design a multi-agent split for my repo by which files each agent writes.
say_en.note: It inventories files and proposes the minimal roster.

say_en.text: Two of my agents keep editing the same file. How do I fix the split?
say_en.note: It finds the overlap and re-allocates surfaces with a reviewer.

say_en.text: Write a surface map and a checking script for our current agents.
say_en.note: Generates a Markdown map and a runnable Node guard.
